title: Wideband LOS Channel
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Environment and Target/Wideband_LOS_Channel.md
text: Wideband line-of-sight propagation channel, 5 inputs, 1 output, {Rain rate (mm/hr)} sets Rainfall rate 0; {Propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Signal carrier frequency (Hz)} sets the signal carrier frequency 3e8, {Number of subbands} sets the number of processing subbands, {Specify atmospheric parameters} enables atmospheric attenuation model, {Temperature (degrees Celsius)} sets the ambient temperature, {Dry air pressure (Pa)} sets the atmospheric dry air pressure, {Water vapour density (g/m^3)} sets the atmospheric water vapor density, {Liquid water density (g/m^3)}, {Perform two-way propagation} enables two-way propagation, {Inherit sample rate}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sampling rate, {Maximum one-way propagation distance (m)} sets the maximum one-way propagation and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
